day12Challenge.title: Distributed Rate Limiter API with Redis & Token Bucket
day12Challenge.audioBrief: Today's challenge focuses on protection against API abuse. You will implement an Express.js middleware using Redis to limit request rates per client IP using the token bucket strategy. This is a favorite system design question in tech interviews!
day12Challenge.overview: Rate limiting is an essential defense mechanism for web APIs. Today you will build a production-ready Express rate-limiter middleware using Redis as an atomic key-value store. You'll enforce a policy of maximum 10 requests per minute per client IP address.
learningObjectives: Master Redis atomic commands (INCR, EXPIRE, EVAL scripts)
Implement the Token Bucket rate-limiting algorithm
Return standardized HTTP 429 status codes with rate-limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset)
Handle Redis connection failure gracefully without crashing the API
requirements: Store client IP keys in Redis with expiration TTL
Add automated jest/supertest test cases verifying rate limiting behavior
day12Challenge.bonusChallenge: Implement a sliding window log counter in Redis Lua script for precise timestamp handling.

faqs.q: What if I have college exams or miss a day?
faqs.a: We know college life gets intense! ABTalks includes a 'Streak Shield & Recovery Quest'. You can recover a missed day within 24 hours by completing a catch-up challenge without resetting your total streak count.

faqs.q: Do I need prior advanced experience to join?
faqs.a: No! We have tracks starting from fundamentals to advanced systems. Each day provides clear instructions, starter templates, and community support.

faqs.q: How do recruiters see my proof of work?
faqs.a: Every verified GitHub commit and LinkedIn post boosts your 'Recruiter Visibility Index'. Top consistent builders get highlighted in our weekly partner talent digest sent directly to tech leads at Razorpay, Postman, Cred, and more.

faqs.q: Is the challenge free for college students?
faqs.a: Yes! The 60-day challenge is 100% free for college students across India.
